name: Micro Credit Finance Scheme (Mahila Samriddhi & Micro Finance)
corporation: National Scheduled Castes Finance and Development Corporation (NSFDC)
description: Financial assistance to marginalized target groups for setting up small, income-generating micro-units such as dairy, petty shops, small-scale farming, and artisan trades.
key_benefits: Up to 95% of project cost funded by NSFDC/Channel Partner
Concessional interest rate of only 4.0% per annum (3.5% for women entrepreneurs)
Flexible moratorium of 3 to 6 months before principal repayment begins
Minimal collateral requirements via State Channelizing Agencies (SCAs)
required_documents: Family Income Certificate / BPL Ration Card

name: Term Loan Scheme for Viable Commercial & Manufacturing Enterprises
corporation: National Scheduled Castes Finance and Development Corporation (NSFDC)
description: Medium to long term financial assistance for commercially viable projects including manufacturing units, service enterprises, commercial transport, and medium-scale agricultural/dairy processing.
key_benefits: Financing up to ₹20,00,000 for scalable business ventures
Up to 90% loan assistance with low promoter contribution (5-10%)
Extended repayment tenure up to 10 years (120 months)
Moratorium period of up to 12 months for enterprise setup and stabilization
required_documents: Family Income Certificate (issued by Revenue Officer / Tehsildar)
Bank Account Details with 6 Months Statement
Detailed Project Report (DPR) with Cost Quotations
Business Premises Lease Agreement or Ownership Proof

name: Educational Loan Scheme for Professional & Higher Technical Education
corporation: National Scheduled Castes Finance and Development Corporation (NSFDC)
description: Concessional education credit for SC students pursuing full-time professional or technical education degrees/diplomas in India or abroad at approved universities and institutions.
key_benefits: Up to ₹10,00,000 for studies in India and up to ₹20,00,000 for studies abroad
Concessional interest rate of 4% p.a. (3.5% for female students)
Moratorium spanning entire course duration + 6 months to 1 year grace period after completion
Covers admission tuition fees, books, equipment, hostel, and travel expenses
required_documents: Income Certificate of Parents / Guardian (<= ₹3,00,000 p.a.)
Proof of Admission in Approved Institution (Admission Offer / Allotment Letter)
Academic Marksheets & Standardized Entrance Exam Scorecards
Schedule of Course Fees and Living Expenses Breakdown
Applicant & Co-Borrower KYC (Aadhaar, PAN, Bank Passbook)
